name: Flamengo 1980 (Cláudio Coutinho)
scopeNote: Flamengo in calendar year 1980: Brasileiro (champion; final v Atletico-MG 0-1 on 1980-05-28 and 3-2 on 1980-06-01, 3-3 aggregate, Flamengo through on better campaign) plus the 1980 Carioca (kicked off 1980-08-17, ended 1980-11-30). Period start 1980-02-24 and end 1980-11-30 are the assumed scope; the end is the date the Carioca ended, not a verified Flamengo match date. Tactical coverage is thin: no tier A source and no source states zonal v man marking for 1980. The nearest term is 'marcação por setor' (Trivela 2011) credited to Coutinho; sources call the style ofensivo, with overlapping fullbacks ('overlapping'), 'ponto futuro' and 'polivalência', high compact lines and pressing; 'Pirâmide Invertida' (via Goal) credits Coutinho's Flamengo with the first Brazilian 4-5-1, while the lineup of the final reads like 4-3-3. Several Coutinho-era statements (1976-80 philosophy) are retrospective and flagged retrospectiveOnly. 1979 and 1981 facts (Carpegiani, Libertadores, Mundial) are excluded. Fact-check 2026-11-06 (managers): pt.wikipedia says Coutinho left after a leaked dispensal list led president Marcio Braga to dismiss him, with no date; Zico (2021) says Carpegiani 'tinha virado técnico no começo do ano' (1981). No source read dates Coutinho's exit or names an interim in Aug-Nov 1980, so managers[] still lists Coutinho to 1980-11-30 as an assumption. The 1980 Carioca final (30 Nov) was Fluminense 1-0 Vasco, not a Flamengo match, so Flamengo's last match date of 1980 is unknown and profilePeriod.end stays 1980-11-30 as the tournament end.
openQuestions: The user has not confirmed this scope: calendar year 1980 (not only the Brasileiro campaign) and not the 1981 Libertadores side under Carpegiani. Period start 1980-02-24 (Santos 0-1 Flamengo) was assumed earlier and not re-verified by any source read here.

Marking (zonal v man): no source says. Trivela 2011 only says 'marcação por setor' was brought by Coutinho (retrospective). Needs match reports or books ('1981', 'Escola Brasileira de Futebol', Placar 1980).

Formation: lineup in the final suggests 4-3-3 (Andrade, Carpegiani, Zico behind Tita, Nunes, Júnior César) while Goal cites 'Pirâmide Invertida' for a first 4-5-1 under Coutinho; no 1980 tactical analysis settles it.
World Soccer (2013) says the 1980 Brasileiro team was coached by Carpegiani; this is an error (Lance, Trivela, Goal all say Coutinho).

UNRESOLVED (checked 2026-11-06): exact date and reason Coutinho left Flamengo. pt.wikipedia gives a reason (leaked dispensal list, dismissed by Marcio Braga) but no date; Zico says Carpegiani was coach 'no começo do ano' 1981. Nobody read states an interim for Aug-Nov 1980, and en.wikipedia 1981 season shows Modesto Bria in charge until 1981-04-05 (not 1980). Next: Jornal do Brasil / Jornal dos Sports Dec 1980 (memoria.bn.gov.br), FlaEstatistica, Terceiro Tempo 'Que fim levou'.

UNRESOLVED: Flamengo's final 1980 Carioca placing: 3rd (en.wikipedia 1981 season page) v 2nd with 33 pts (en.wikipedia Carioca page table); the pt page lists the champion and runner-up as Fluminense and Vasco in the final, which was Fluminense 1-0 Vasco on 1980-11-30, so Flamengo did not play it. Flamengo's last match date remains unknown.

sources.title: Nunes explica o gol que acendeu a chama da rivalidade (Trivela)

Mostrava o esquema tático do Atlético e conversava em cima desse esquema tático do Atlético
